svg.title: Structured output: the answer of every task, by strategy and model
svg.desc: A grid with one row per model and strategy and one column per task: 20 chain tasks and 19 SQL tasks, each with lookup tools. A blue square is a correct structured answer, a light rose square a wrong value, an empty square no structured answer, and a solid rose square a raised error. On Qwen3 4B, ToolStrategy gave no answer in 39 of 39 tasks and ProviderStrategy raised in 10 of 10. A second model call that extracts the answer from the final text was correct in 30 of 39 on Qwen3 4B, 26 on Qwen3 8B and 39 on Claude Haiku 5.5. Free text read by its last number was correct in 15 of 39 on Haiku.
svg.text: Qwen3 4B ProviderStrategy ran 10 of the tasks. Every run on the Mac, Haiku through the API.
